_comment: Hand-authored half of the app-download catalog. Copy to platforms.json
in the staging root, then run scripts/app-downloads/gen-catalog.mjs.
Only what CANNOT be derived from the staged bytes belongs here: the
version string, store URLs, minimum OS, and any human note. Sizes,
sha256 digests and which asset is the installer are all derived by the
generator, because a hand-maintained digest is one that goes stale.
A platform with no staged artifacts and no entry here simply does not
appear in the catalog, and the page says so honestly.
NO storeUrl APPEARS BELOW, AND THAT IS DELIBERATE. This file is copied
verbatim by anyone following README.md step 3, so a placeholder here
ships a customer a dead button — strictly worse than the honest empty
state. The two that used to live here were exactly that: a Play listing
for ai.warplab.droplet that 404s, and the literal string
Add a storeUrl only once the listing actually resolves in a browser.
For a Play internal test the correct shape is
that id; it cannot be hand-constructed from the applicationId.

android.note: The Android app installs from Google Play once it is listed; until then the box serves the APK directly.

ios.note: iPhone and iPad builds are distributed through Apple, not from this box — iOS does not allow installing apps from a local device.
